scope: Development and feasibility. Independent Codex proxy references under operator instruction. Real human minutes and human agreement unavailable.
validation_selection: Four earliest original receipts among the previous 12 evaluation candidates, ordered by receipt_no. They are retired from subsequent evaluation.
final_evaluation: Choose sample size from valid paired enterprises after validation. Reserve unopened firms. Only release effectiveness claims after preregistration and coverage checks.
materiality: confirmed fact/missing counterevidence materially changes the selection or calculation, or supported alternative changes value by at least 5%; a sensitivity alone is insufficient
required: confirmed material deterministic errors remain mandatory for both arms
rank_order: L3-rule: sourced challenge, unknown, remaining; supported original price impact descending (missing last), then item ID. Compare ties before ID.
operating_rule: L3 sends supported challenges up to K plus mandatory. AI sends proposed human-review items up to K plus mandatory. Other states tracked individually.
metrics: Within-company material versus nonmaterial pair concordance outside mandatory, same-K misses, recall, K=1, pending bounds, operating transfers and missed material items. Materiality determined by proxy panel in this run.
tolerance: Development automation expansion requires zero additional material misses vs paired operational baseline. Never enable skip/requestion without observed trigger and subsequent validation.
source_access: common page excerpts in context and at most 4 additional physical pages per company via one bounded lookup round, incl. adjacent pages when needed. Original PDF only. Same labels and price inputs in both H1 arms.
budgets: selector 180 s per case, 2 model decision calls plus one invalid-format repair, max 4 transport attempts, 12k output tokens total, USD 1.25 upper bound. Raw requests, response IDs, tokens, lookup IDs, run time and costs retained.
quality_gates: exercise normal, missing and false cases plus reference linkage
verify final arithmetic, artifacts and audit trail before dependent stage
b_comparison: Within-filing A0 focused supplementary B-input experiment, fixed item list, page excerpts and configuration. Log findings separately from full A0 baseline.
potential_followups: Conditional H2 only if H1 and safe deferral candidates justify it. One re-question experiment only after repeated unresolved referral type. Historic v5 needs already-frozen eligible pair, do not change old assignments.
